2609.38355.title: Halluscoring 2026: The first shared task on llms hallucination detection and answer verification
2609.38355.paper_summary: We present HalluScoring 2026, a shared task for evaluating hallucination detection and factual verification in Arabic question answering under challenging generalization settings. The shared task is organized into two main tasks, each comprising two subtasks, for a total of four subtasks. Task 1 evaluates binary hallucination detection, considering generalization to unseen questions (Subtask 1.1) and responses generated by unseen LLMs (Subtask 1.2). Task 2 extends the evaluation beyond detection by requiring the systems to additionally identify the correct factual answer from six related candidates, covering Islamic knowledge (Subtask 2.1) and general knowledge (Subtask 2.2). The shared task is based on two Arabic datasets: HalluScore and HalluTruthQA. A total of 13 teams participated in the shared task, 10 of which submitted system description papers. The results of Task 1 demonstrate that hallucination detection remains challenging under distribution shift, with the winning team achieving AUC-ROC test scores of 0.772 and 0.767 for Subtasks 1.1 and 1.2, respectively. For Task 2, the winning team achieved scores of 0.882 and 0.857 in the Islamic and general-knowledge subtasks, respectively, under assisted evaluation.
2609.38355.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 HalluScoring 2026，這是一個針對阿拉伯語問題回答中幻覺檢測和事實驗證的共享任務，面對具有挑戰性的泛化設置。該共享任務分為兩個主要任務，每個任務包含兩個子任務，共計四個子任務。任務 1 評估二元幻覺檢測，考慮到對未見問題的泛化（子任務 1.1）和由未見 LLM 生成的回應（子任務 1.2）。任務 2 擴展了評估，要求系統額外從六個相關候選答案中識別正確的事實答案，涵蓋伊斯蘭知識（子任務 2.1）和一般知識（子任務 2.2）。該共享任務基於兩個阿拉伯語數據集：HalluScore 和 HalluTruthQA。共有 13 支隊伍參加了該共享任務，其中 10 支提交了系統描述論文。任務 1 的結果顯示，在分佈轉移下，幻覺檢測仍然具有挑戰性，獲勝隊伍在子任務 1.1 和 1.2 的 AUC-ROC 測試分數分別達到 0.772 和 0.767。對於任務 2，獲勝隊伍在伊斯蘭和一般知識子任務中的得分分別為 0.882 和 0.857，這是在輔助評估下取得的。
